content.text:
The crate was already in decent shape, so I made three small, behavior-preserving commits. All tests pass, and clippy is clean with no warnings.

1. **`c40db03` – Name the attribute range limits.** The visibility-timeout and delay limits (`43_200`, `900`) were written out separately in the attribute parsing and in the message commands. They now share one named constant each, and the retention and max-receive-count ranges are named too.
2. **`079193e` – Error constructors.** I added `Error::invalid_value`, `Error::missing` and `Error::unsupported`. These replace private helpers that were re-declared in several modules, and a few call sites that spelled out `Error::new` with the same code and message.
3. **`854786d` – Split up `send_message`.** The read-only FIFO checks now live in `resolve_fifo_ids`, which returns either a duplicate of an earlier send or a new message. `send_message` is now shorter, and the order of its checks is unchanged.

I left the rest alone on purpose. The module split, doc comments and tests were already good. The create and set-attributes validation looks similar, but the two differ in their error messages and check order, so merging them would risk changing behavior.

The crate was already in decent shape, so I made three small, behavior-preserving commits. All tests pass, and clippy is clean with no warnings.

1. **`c40db03` – Name the attribute range limits.** The visibility-timeout and delay limits (`43_200`, `900`) were written out separately in the attribute parsing and in the message commands. They now share one named constant each, and the retention and max-receive-count ranges are named too.
2. **`079193e` – Error constructors.** I added `Error::invalid_value`, `Error::missing` and `Error::unsupported`. These replace private helpers that were re-declared in several modules, and a few call sites that spelled out `Error::new` with the same code and message.
3. **`854786d` – Split up `send_message`.** The read-only FIFO checks now live in `resolve_fifo_ids`, which returns either a duplicate of an earlier send or a new message. `send_message` is now shorter, and the order of its checks is unchanged.

I left the rest alone on purpose. The module split, doc comments and tests were already good. The create and set-attributes validation looks similar, but the two differ in their error messages and check order, so merging them would risk changing behavior.
